outline:
本課程著重於商業溝通及實務的應用。每個實例討論均能幫助學生了解英文商務應用，並且提供學生去研習，分析並將個人論點英文表達。課程的重點有二：加強學生理解英文在商業領域的重要性，增強學生在商業案件中的綜合分析的表達能力。此外，由實際的商業實務中反應出各種未來可能出現的不同挑戰，讓學生有機會學習應對。根據課程規定，學生須具備高級英文的能力跟基本的商業知識。
The course explores the intersection of the English language communication and cases in real business world. Each case to be discussed in this course illustrates the many aspects of business operations and provides students with the opportunities to examine, to analyze and to present their views in English. The emphasis of the course is two-fold. While reinforcing the importance of business communications in English and enhancing students' analytical competence in discussing the cases, real-world business stories reflect a multitude of challenges to resolve and opportunities to embrace in hopes that students are well-prepare to cope with all these in the future to come. As the course prescribes, students are required to have an advanced English level and fundamental business knowledge.

This course is designed to provide students with a practical understanding of marketing and consumer market development through real-world business case studies. By analyzing different marketing strategies, consumer behavior trends, and market development approaches, students will develop critical thinking, problem-solving, and strategic analysis skills. Through case study presentations, group discussions, and written reflections, students will apply theoretical marketing concepts to real-world business challenges.This course will emphasize market expansion, brand positioning, digital marketing trends, and consumer engagement strategies, providing valuable insights for future business professionals.

Course Requirements
Students’ responsibilities in this class include:
1. Attendance and Participation – Regular attendance and active engagement in discussions are required.
2. Case Study Presentations
Each student (or group) will be assigned a business case focused on marketing and consumer markets. Presentations must include key insights, strategic challenges, and potential solutions. Students must provide a summary handout before their presentation.
4. Reflection Report
Students must submit a comprehensive case analysis report (4-7 pages) summarizing key takeaways and/or integrating insights from multiple case studies covered in class.

Semester Grading Policy
The six-week course will account for 33% of the total semester grade, with students assessed based on their presentations, reflection report, and participation. Grades will be prorated accordingly within the overall semester evaluation.
1. Case Study Presentations 50%
2. Reflection Report 30%
3. Attendance & Participation 20%

Attendance Policy
Students are required to attend all class sessions on time.
Each absence will result in a 10% deduction from the final semester grade.
A university-approved leave document may waive one absence penalty per semester.
AWOLs (absences without leave) will be recorded and included in the penalty calculation if not rectified within two weeks.
The instructor reserves the right to modify this syllabus. Any changes to the grading policy will be discussed in class.
